# What this source is good for

Almost nothing that is independent. It is a blog on the operator's **own private server** (it advertises
"Play OGameXL Free" in the body), it cites no source, and its numbers reproduce the Fandom
`Defense Build Strategies` page (`WIK-013`) nearly line for line. **Do not count it as corroboration of
WIK-013** — as evidence this is one source, not two.

## Dependency evidence (why it is not an independent source)

| ogame.life section | WIK-013 section | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| "Early Game Defense Ratio": Light Laser 200 / RL 300–400 / HL 20 (1 per 10 LL) / Ion 10 (1 per 20) / Gauss 4 (1 per 50) / both domes 1 each / ABM 20 | "Early Game Defense": same ratios, same 300–400 RL range | copied |
| "A Balanced, General-Purpose Ratio": LL 100, RL 20, Ion 20, HL 10, Gauss 10, Plasma 5 | "Balanced Defense": "for every 100 Light Lasers … 20 Rocket Launchers, 20 Ion Cannons, 10 Heavy Lasers, 10 Gauss Cannons, and 5 Plasma Turrets" | copied |
| "Big Gun Heavy (Mid-to-Late Game)": RL 1,000 / LL 500 / HL 100 / Ion 40 / Gauss 20 / Plasma 10; "roughly 4.4M Metal, 1.55M Crystal, 340K Deuterium" | "Big Gun Heavy": same list; "4,390,000 / 1,550,000 / 340,000" | copied |
| "The Equivalent Effective Cost Method" | "Equivalent Effective Cost Defence for Turtling" | renamed and shortened |

Its one addition over WIK-013 is a worked example of the same method: "roughly 2,000,000 effective metal
spent on a mixed defense line (about 1,000 Rocket Launchers, 850 Light Lasers, 200 Heavy Lasers, 160 Ion
Cannons, 40 Gauss Cannons, and 10 Plasma Turrets) can comfortably defeat an attacking fleet built for the
same effective cost, whether that fleet is 2,500 Light Fighters, 320 Cruisers, 170 Battleships, or a
single Death Star." No techs, no simulator, no seed, no variance measure are given for that claim.

## Claims worth recording as *stated positions* (not as numbers)

> There's no single ratio that wins against every fleet, because the attacker always has the initiative:
> they scout you first, see exactly what you've built, and bring the composition that beats it. What a
> good defense ratio actually does is make attacking you unprofitable, not guarantee a win.

> Defense protects your planet's production between logins; it does not replace fleetsaving, the two work
> together, not as substitutes for each other.

> Plasma Turrets and Shield Domes have no Rapid Fire against them from any ship, including
> Reapers/Deathstars, making them the backbone of any late-game defense meant to survive a serious attack.

> Cruisers get Rapid Fire against Rocket Launchers, so a defense built entirely on Rocket Launcher fodder
> is unusually weak to Cruiser-heavy raiding fleets, mixing in Light Lasers (which Cruisers don't get
> Rapid Fire against) closes that gap.

**Caution:** the last two are consistent with WIK-013's layering claims, but both pages are community
text. They remain `CONTESTED` until an official/host source confirms the rapid-fire table.

## Verdict for the corpus

Keep as a **negative control**: it is the shape of source that an unattributed-guide search returns at
the top of Google, and its ratios cannot be used to raise the confidence of WIK-013.
